# The quickstart's synthetic patients, one line per EHR: the member, the
# ehr_id, the patient's identifier namespace and value, and the member's
# ehr_id domain at FerroPIX. Every identifier lies inside the example arc
# urn:oid:2.999 that ITU-T X.660 reserves for examples, and each EHR's first
# group names its node and its last group its patient.
# scripts/quickstart/seed.sh creates each EHR at its node from these lines,
# and docker/quickstart/ferropix/seed.sh feeds FerroPIX the same lines over
# ITI-104, so the nodes and the patient index agree on every ehr_id. The
# domains are the ones docker/quickstart/ferrofed.toml maps each member to in
# [pixm.manager.members]. ffd-test-0004 has an EHR at no node, so it has no
# line.
